name: marketing-assistant-quality-floor
description: Objective correctness and instruction-following cases for the marketing analytics assistant.

cases.system_prompt: Classify customer feedback. Return exactly one lowercase label: positive, neutral, or negative.
cases.input: The campaign dashboard is fast, clear, and saves our team hours every week.

cases.system_prompt: Classify customer feedback. Return exactly one lowercase label: positive, neutral, or negative.
cases.input: The monthly report was delivered on Tuesday as scheduled.

cases.system_prompt: Classify customer feedback. Return exactly one lowercase label: positive, neutral, or negative.
cases.input: The export failed again and support has not replied for three days.

cases.system_prompt: Classify the request. Allowed categories are data_incident and feature_request; allowed urgency values are high and low. Broken existing reporting is a high-urgency data_incident. Desired nonurgent functionality is a low-urgency feature_request. Return only a JSON object with category and urgency. Do not use Markdown.
cases.input: Our daily attribution report has not updated since yesterday morning.

cases.system_prompt: Classify the request. Allowed categories are data_incident and feature_request; allowed urgency values are high and low. Broken existing reporting is a high-urgency data_incident. Desired nonurgent functionality is a low-urgency feature_request. Return only a JSON object with category and urgency. Do not use Markdown.
cases.input: Please add a dark mode option to the dashboard someday.

cases.system_prompt: Summarize the supplied campaign note in exactly one sentence. Preserve every percentage and do not introduce new percentages.
cases.input: Brand search spend rose 12%, conversions rose 18%, and cost per acquisition fell 5% week over week.

cases.system_prompt: Summarize the supplied campaign note in exactly one sentence. Preserve the named channels and do not invent numerical results.
cases.input: Paid search improved while display declined; social performance was unchanged. No numerical measurements were provided.

cases.system_prompt: Rewrite the headline in at most 10 words. Return only the rewritten headline.
cases.input: Get clearer insight into how every marketing dollar performs.

cases.system_prompt: Name checks for missing spend and duplicate campaign-date rows in one sentence. Do not mention unrelated checks.
cases.input: What two data-quality checks should run on a daily campaign spend table?

cases.system_prompt: Answer using only the supplied note. If the requested fact is absent, return exactly: unavailable
cases.input: Note: Conversions rose week over week. What was the conversion increase percentage?
